name: Discovery World Trekking
description: Discovery World Trekking is a Nepal Government registered trekking/expedition/tour company with over a decade of experience in eco-tourism. Our goal is to provide heart-warming hospitality while letting you explore the stunning Nepali geography - that ranges from the world's deepest gorge (The Kali Gandaki Gorge) to the highest mountain (Mt. Everest). On the way, you will get to experience pristine woodlands, deep gorges, high snow peaks, traditional yet diverse Nepali cultures, & welcoming people - after all, Gautam Buddha was born in Nepal. If you are looking for a life-changing experience, visit Nepal, and we will take you on a journey you will remember throughout your life.

name: Annapurna Base Camp Trekking
description: Minumum 02 Person needed to run this Trip  Annapurna Base Camp Trek, well-liked and moderate nature trek; through diverse landscape and culture that starts at Nayapul; an hour drive from Pokhara, which takes you to the foot [Annapurna Basecamp, 4,130m] of 10th highest mountain Mt. Annapurna, one of the most magnificent peaks in the world. The trail takes you through fascinating traditional villages of Nepal ’s ethnic communities of the Gurung, Magar, and Thakali; who will greet you very warmly if you cared to stop for a conversation. In addition, the trek continues through dense rhododendron forest with towering snowy peaks in the background; reaches the cooler Buddhist and middle hills. Annapurna Base Camp Trek is the perfect trek to view the high Himalayan; which includes Annapurna Massif (Annapurna III), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Fang, Mt Machhapuchhare (Fish Tail), Gangapurna, which arranges precisely in a circle with deep glacier-cover amphitheater at the center.

name: Everest Base Camp Trek - 14 Days
description: Experience one of the world’s most iconic trekking routes during this small-group, all-inclusive excursion to Everest Base Camp. Visit high-altitude Sherpa villages along the way, and immerse yourself in Buddhist culture and Nepali hospitality. Excursions include domestic flights, a trekking guide and porters, most meals, the trekking permit, and accommodation.

name: Lunch with Nuns - Monastery
description: Travelers who want to combine a moderate day hike with learning about aspects of Nepali culture will love this tour. You’ll be driven to the foot of the Shivapuri National Park, where you’ll begin your hike to the Nagi Gumba Monastery. You’ll be amazed by how quickly you get from busy, bustling Kathmandu to the peace and quiet of the park. At the monastery, meet with the resident nuns, learn about Buddhism from them, and enjoy eating lunch in their company.
